defaults.about_intro: Hi, my name is David VanDyke, and I'm proud to serve Indiana families with honest, personalized insurance guidance. I'm passionate about helping people protect the things they love most.
defaults.about_personal: When I'm not helping clients, I enjoy watching sports (Go Blue!), collecting fountain pens, and reading books beside a cozy fire. Most of all, I love spending time with my wife, Caroline, and our four wonderful children—Weston, August, Callum, and Charlotte. Whether it's cheering on my favorite team or spending time with family, I'm grateful for every day.
defaults.about_shield: Shield is an independent agency with a long track record of serving families across multiple states including Indiana. I'm proud to be part of those strong client relationships, and I can compare options across a broad marketplace of carriers to match coverage and budgets with confidence.

why_choose.headline: Why Choose David?
why_choose.intro: As an independent agent, I work for you—not an insurance company. That means I can shop multiple carriers to find the best coverage at the right price.

services.headline: Insurance Services
services.intro: I help families and businesses find the right coverage at the right price. Not sure what you need? Just ask.

items.title: Auto Insurance
items.desc: Liability, collision, comprehensive, and full coverage for your vehicles.

items.title: Homeowners Insurance
items.desc: Protect your home, belongings, and liability with the right homeowners policy.

items.title: Life Insurance
items.desc: Term and permanent life insurance to protect the people who depend on you.

items.title: Business Insurance
items.desc: General liability, property, workers' comp, and more for Indiana businesses.

items.title: Contractors Insurance
items.desc: Specialized coverage for electricians, plumbers, HVAC techs, and other tradespeople.

items.title: Disability Insurance
items.desc: Income protection if an illness or injury keeps you from working.

items.title: Flood Insurance
items.desc: Flood damage isn't covered by standard homeowners policies. I can help you get covered.

items.title: Health & Dental
items.desc: Individual and family health and dental plans to keep you covered.

items.title: Medicare
items.desc: Medicare Supplement and Medicare Advantage plans to fill the gaps in your coverage.

items.title: Special Event Insurance
items.desc: Short-term coverage for weddings, festivals, and other events.

items.title: Other Coverage
items.desc: Umbrella, renters, RV, boat, motorcycle, and more. If you need it, I can probably help.

items.title: Pet Insurance
items.desc: Coverage for vet bills, surgeries, and medications to keep your pets healthy.

items.q: What types of insurance do you offer?
items.a: I can help with auto, home, life, Medicare, business, and more. If you're not sure where your need fits, just ask and I'll point you in the right direction.

Yes! Shield Insurance Agency is licensed in Indiana and I proudly serve families throughout the state. Shield is also licensed in additional states (AZ, FL, IL, MI, MO, NC, OH, UT), so if you're outside Indiana, I can connect you with a Shield agent in your area.

items.q: How do I get a quote?
items.a: Book a free 15-minute call using the scheduling link, or call or email me directly. I'll walk you through your options and gather the info I need to get you accurate quotes.

items.q: What information will you need from me?
items.a: It depends on your situation, but I'll usually ask for basic driver details, vehicles, and your current address. For home coverage, I may ask about the property, roof age, and systems. I'll keep it simple and guide you through it.
